Khronos glTF Sample Assets — selected models
Source: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets (Models/<Name>/glTF-Binary/<Name>.glb), fetched October 9, 2026.
Converted to OBJ/MTL with base-colour textures downscaled to 512–1024 px; shapes unchanged. Each model's own
README in that repository states its license. Attribution for the CC BY models is reproduced here and in
Docs/ASSET_REGISTER.md.

TrafficCone — © 2024 hinndia. Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ — ground plane removed; used as the scene-cone visual.
SheenChair — © 2020 Wayfair, LLC. Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal (CC0).
GlamVelvetSofa — © 2021 Wayfair, LLC. CC BY 4.0.
SunglassesKhronos — © 2024 Darmstadt Graphics Group GmbH. CC BY 4.0.
GlassVaseFlowers — © 2023, released to the public (CC0).
WaterBottle — © 2017 Microsoft, released to the public (CC0).
Lantern — © 2017 Microsoft, released to the public (CC0). Scaled to 3 m for use as a street lamp.
ChronographWatch — © 2025 Darmstadt Graphics Group GmbH. CC BY 4.0. Based on "Chronograph Watch Mudmaster"
  by graphiccompressor (https://skfb.ly/oAsPA), CC BY 4.0. Decimated to about 15k triangles, scaled to metres.
DiffuseTransmissionPlant — © 2024 Darmstadt Graphics Group GmbH. CC BY 4.0. Decimated to about 15k triangles.
GlassHurricaneCandleHolder — © 2021 Wayfair, LLC. CC BY 4.0.
IridescenceLamp — © 2022 Wayfair, LLC. CC BY 4.0. Decimated to about 15k triangles.
ChairDamaskPurplegold — © 2021 Wayfair. CC BY 4.0. Decimated to about 10k triangles.

CC BY 4.0 requires that this attribution travels with the demo. Sample-asset READMEs: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models
